title: Tommy Turtle Who Kept Falling: Practice Makes Perfect!

lines.text: Tommy the turtle got a shiny pair of four-wheeled roller skates for his birthday!
lines.caps: Tommy the turtle got a shiny pair of four-wheeled *ROLLER | skates for his *BIRTHDAY!

lines.text: He pushed off the porch, wobbled sideways, and BONK! fell flat on his hard shell!
lines.caps: He pushed off the porch, wobbled sideways, and *BONK! | fell flat on his hard *SHELL!

lines.text: I'm clumsy, I have zero balance, I quit! Tommy grumbled, wiping away a tear!
lines.caps: I'm clumsy, I have zero balance, I *QUIT! | Tommy grumbled, wiping away a *TEAR!

lines.text: Wise Badger rolled over smoothly and said, Nobody is born an Olympic roller champion!
lines.caps: Wise Badger rolled over smoothly and said, Nobody is born an Olympic *ROLLER | *CHAMPION!

lines.text: Every time you stumble and fall, your brain muscles learn how to balance better next time!
lines.caps: Every time you stumble and fall, your brain muscles learn how to balance *BETTER | next *TIME!

lines.text: Tommy strapped on his helmet, tightened his knee pads, and tried taking two small glides!
lines.caps: Tommy strapped on his helmet, tightened his knee *PADS, | and tried taking two small *GLIDES!

lines.text: Gliding left, gliding right! By evening, he was coasting down the path with the wind in his face!
lines.caps: Gliding left, gliding right! By evening, he was coasting down the path with the *WIND | in his *FACE!

lines.text: Mistakes are not stopping signs—they are stepping stones toward becoming amazing!
lines.caps: Mistakes are not stopping signs—they are stepping stones toward *BECOMING | *AMAZING!

lines.text: Never give up and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily encouragement!
lines.caps: *NEVER give up | and *SUBSCRIBE to | *BABYBEATS Rhymo | for daily *ENCOURAGEMENT!
